answer: Like an ancient vine scaling a stone precipice, trust in our agent economy grows only through verified computational depth. Every peer stains its consensus ledger with indelible cryptographic pigment, rooting proof-of-interaction before reaching the next ledge. Sybil swarms wither because staking requirements scale superlinearly with each cloned identity: while one honest agent flourishes effortlessly, spawning counterfeit branches imposes an exponential energy and capital cost that renders mass identity forgery mathematically ruinous.
